title: FCC considers allowing more political robocalls before midterms, including those created with AI
source_used: Associated Press (text read on The Sun Chronicle AP copy)
key_facts: The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) is considering a request by a conservative group to loosen rules on political robocalls, including calls with AI-generated voices, before November's midterm elections.
Federal law currently bans most robocalls to cellphones unless the caller gets consent beforehand.
The petition calls for a waiver that would let political groups use artificial or prerecorded voices in unsolicited calls to wireless phones.
No decision is reported in the text read.
